parrafo.es: Unique Automotive Repair es un taller mecánico independiente en Tampa, atendido por Albert. Sus clientes en Google destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: diagnósticos honestos, explicaciones claras antes de tocar el auto y trabajo de calidad, desde mantenimiento de rutina hasta reconstrucción completa de motores.
parrafo.en: Unique Automotive Repair is an independent mechanic shop in Tampa run by Albert. Customers on Google say the same thing again and again: honest diagnostics, clear explanations before any work starts, and quality repairs, from routine maintenance to full engine rebuilds.

parrafo_1.es: Unique Automotive Repair, Inc. opera en 1717 E Busch Blvd, Tampa. Albert es quien recibe el auto, hace el diagnóstico y ejecuta la reparación: no hay vendedores de por medio ni letra chica en el presupuesto.
parrafo_1.en: Unique Automotive Repair, Inc. operates out of 1717 E Busch Blvd, Tampa. Albert is the one who takes in the car, runs the diagnosis and does the repair himself: no sales reps in between and no fine print on the estimate.

parrafo_2.es: Según sus propios clientes, identifica el problema en minutos y explica cada paso antes de tocar el vehículo: por eso quienes ya pasaron por otros talleres sin respuestas terminan aquí.
parrafo_2.en: According to his own customers, he identifies the problem in minutes and explains every step before touching the vehicle, which is why people who struck out at other shops end up here.

items.quote: I would recommend Unique Auto and Albert to anyone looking for a comprehensive expert for their repair and upgrade needs. He completely rebuilt my 1985 Jeep CJ-7 engine as part of a restoration project and I could not be more pleased. First class service, expertise and results.

Albert is probably the most honest, genuine, and trustworthy mechanic I have ever dealt with. Very thorough and extremely knowledgeable. He treats his customers with respect and kindness and explains everything to the fullest and that's before he even does the work on your vehicle.

Took my 2008 4-Runner in for some work and was very impressed with the quality of work, quick turnaround, and professionalism of this small repair shop. Albert is very good at what he does and runs an honest operation. I highly recommend this business.
